summary_zh: 失去母亲的小女孩辛贝格维尔在生母留下的温暖彩毯中寻找慰藉。当父亲迎娶新继母安妮塔后，严苛的繁重家务让女孩不堪重负。在父亲出差期间，继母的严厉惩罚与扯破的彩毯迫使她出走到溪边大树上避难。溪水旁洗衣的姑母通过歌声与彩毯认出侄女并给予庇护。得知真相后，深爱女儿的父亲赶到姑母家支持她的决定，继母也真诚登门道歉悔过。在亲情的理解、尊重与包容中，破碎的家庭最终迎来和解与希望。

sentences.text: When Simbegwire’s mother died, she was very sad.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的母亲去世时，她非常悲伤。

sentences.text: Simbegwire’s father did his best to take care of his daughter.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的父亲竭尽全力照顾自己的女儿。

sentences.text: Slowly, they learned to feel happy again, without Simbegwire’s mother.
sentences.translation_zh: 渐渐地，在没有辛贝格维尔母亲的生活里，他们学会了重新感到快乐。

sentences.text: Every morning they sat and talked about the day ahead.
sentences.translation_zh: 每天早晨，他们坐在一起，聊着接下来一天的安排。

phrases.gloss_zh: 新的一天；接下来的日子

sentences.text: Every evening they made dinner together.
sentences.translation_zh: 每天傍晚，他们一起做晚饭。

sentences.text: After they washed the dishes, Simbegwire’s father helped her with homework.
sentences.translation_zh: 洗完碗后，辛贝格维尔的父亲会辅导她做家庭作业。

sentences.text: One day, Simbegwire’s father came home later than usual.
sentences.translation_zh: 有一天，辛贝格维尔的父亲比平时回来得晚。

sentences.text: “Where are you my child?” he called.
sentences.translation_zh: “你在哪里，我的孩子？”他喊道。

sentences.text: Simbegwire ran to her father.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔跑向父亲。

sentences.text: She stopped still when she saw that he was holding a woman’s hand.
sentences.translation_zh: 当看到父亲牵着一个女人的手时，她一下子愣在原地停下了脚步。

sentences.text: “I want you to meet someone special, my child.
sentences.translation_zh: “我想让你见见一位特别的人，我的孩子。

sentences.text: This is Anita,” he said smiling.
sentences.translation_zh: 这位是安妮塔，”他微笑着说。

sentences.text: “Hello Simbegwire, your father told me a lot about you,” said Anita.
sentences.translation_zh: “你好，辛贝格维尔，你父亲跟我提过很多关于你的事，”安妮塔说。

sentences.text: But she did not smile or take the girl’s hand.
sentences.translation_zh: 但她既没有微笑，也没有去牵小女孩的手。

sentences.text: Simbegwire’s father was happy and excited.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的父亲满心欢喜，十分兴奋。

sentences.text: He talked about the three of them living together, and how good their life would be.
sentences.translation_zh: 他畅谈着他们三个人往后一起生活的情景，以及未来的日子该有多么美好。

sentences.text: “My child, I hope you will accept Anita as your mother,” he said.
sentences.translation_zh: “我的孩子，我希望你能把安妮塔当作自己的母亲接纳她，”他说道。

sentences.text: Simbegwire’s life changed.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的生活改变了。

sentences.text: She no longer had time to sit with her father in the mornings.
sentences.translation_zh: 早晨她不再有时间坐下来陪伴父亲。

sentences.text: Anita gave her so many household chores that she was too tired to do her school work in the evenings.
sentences.translation_zh: 安妮塔给她布置了太多家务活，以至于她晚上累得根本无力做功课。

sentences.text: She went straight to bed after dinner.
sentences.translation_zh: 吃完晚饭后，她就直接上床睡觉了。

sentences.text: Her only comfort was the colourful blanket her mother gave her.
sentences.translation_zh: 她唯一的慰藉，就是母亲留给她的那条色彩斑斓的毛毯。

sentences.text: Simbegwire’s father did not seem to notice that his daughter was unhappy.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的父亲似乎并没有察觉到女儿的不快乐。

sentences.text: A few months later, her father left on a work trip.
sentences.translation_zh: 几个月后，她的父亲出门出差了。

sentences.text: He told them to look after each other.
sentences.translation_zh: 他嘱咐她们要互相照顾。

sentences.text: He did not see Simbegwire’s face fall.
sentences.translation_zh: 他没有看到辛贝格维尔的脸色一下子沉了下来。

sentences.text: While he was away, Anita hit Simbegwire if she complained or left her chores unfinished.
sentences.translation_zh: 在他出差期间，如果辛贝格维尔抱怨或没做完家务，安妮塔就会动手打她。

sentences.text: At dinner she gave the girl only scraps.
sentences.translation_zh: 吃晚饭时，她只给小女孩吃残羹剩饭。

sentences.text: Simbegwire cried herself to sleep, hugging her mother’s blanket.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔抱着母亲的毛毯，哭着睡着了。

sentences.text: One morning, Simbegwire was late getting out of bed.
sentences.translation_zh: 一天早晨，辛贝格维尔起床起晚了。

sentences.text: “You lazy girl!”
sentences.translation_zh: “你这个懒丫头！”

sentences.text: Anita shouted.
sentences.translation_zh: 安妮塔吼道。

sentences.text: She pulled Simbegwire out of bed.
sentences.translation_zh: 她一把将辛贝格维尔从床上拽了起来。

sentences.text: The precious blanket caught on a nail, and tore in two.
sentences.translation_zh: 那条珍贵的毛毯挂在一根钉子上，被撕成了两半。

sentences.text: Simbegwire was very upset.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔难过极了。

sentences.text: She decided to run away from home.
sentences.translation_zh: 她决定离家出走。

sentences.text: She took the pieces of her mother’s blanket, packed some food, and left the house.
sentences.translation_zh: 她带上母亲毛毯的碎块，装了些食物，离开了家。

sentences.text: She followed the road her father had taken.
sentences.translation_zh: 她沿着父亲出差时走的那条路向前走去。

sentences.text: At dusk, Simbegwire made herself a bed in the branches of a tall tree by a stream.
sentences.translation_zh: 黄昏时分，辛贝格维尔在溪边一棵大树的枝桠间给自己铺了一个栖身之处。

sentences.text: Before falling asleep, she sang about how much she missed her mother.
sentences.translation_zh: 入睡前，她轻声唱起歌，唱着自己有多么思念母亲。

sentences.text: The next morning, Simbegwire sang the song again.
sentences.translation_zh: 第二天早晨，辛贝格维尔又唱起了那首歌。

sentences.text: When the women came to wash their clothes at the stream, they heard the sad song coming from the tall tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 当妇人们来到溪边洗衣服时，她们听到了从那棵大树上传来的忧伤歌声。

sentences.text: They thought it was only the wind rustling the leaves, and carried on with their work.
sentences.translation_zh: 她们以为那只是风吹树叶的沙沙声，便继续干着手里的活。

sentences.text: But one of the women listened very carefully to the song.
sentences.translation_zh: 但其中一位妇女却非常仔细地倾听着这阵歌声。

sentences.text: This woman looked up into the tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 这位妇人抬头向树上望去。

sentences.text: When she saw the girl and the pieces of colourful blanket, she cried, “Simbegwire, my brother’s child!”
sentences.translation_zh: 当她看清小女孩以及那撕成两半的彩色毛毯时，她惊呼道：“辛贝格维尔，我兄弟的孩子！”

sentences.text: The other women stopped washing and helped Simbegwire to climb down from the tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 其他妇女立刻停下洗衣服，帮着辛贝格维尔从树上爬了下来。

sentences.text: Her aunt hugged the little girl and tried to comfort her.
sentences.translation_zh: 姑母紧紧抱住小女孩，轻声抚慰她。

sentences.text: Simbegwire’s aunt took the child to her own house.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的姑母把孩子带回了自己家。

sentences.text: She gave Simbegwire warm food, and tucked her in bed with her mother’s blanket.
sentences.translation_zh: 她给辛贝格维尔热了饭菜，又用她母亲的毛毯帮她掖好被角哄她入睡。

sentences.text: That night, Simbegwire cried as she went to sleep.
sentences.translation_zh: 那天晚上，辛贝格维尔入睡时又哭了。

sentences.text: But they were tears of relief.
sentences.translation_zh: 但那是释怀与安心的泪水。

sentences.text: She knew her aunt would look after her.
sentences.translation_zh: 她知道姑母会悉心照顾她。

sentences.text: When Simbegwire’s father returned home, he found her room empty.
sentences.translation_zh: 当辛贝格维尔的父亲回到家中时，发现女儿的房间空空如也。

sentences.text: “What happened, Anita?” he asked with a heavy heart.
sentences.translation_zh: “发生了什么事，安妮塔？”他心情沉重地问道。

sentences.text: The woman explained that Simbegwire had run away.
sentences.translation_zh: 女人解释说辛贝格维尔离家出走了。

sentences.text: “I wanted her to respect me,” she said.
sentences.translation_zh: “我只是想让她尊重我，”她说。

sentences.text: “But perhaps I was too strict.”
sentences.translation_zh: “但也许我管得太严了。”

sentences.text: Simbegwire’s father left the house and went in the direction of the stream.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔的父亲立刻离开家，朝着小溪的方向奔去。

sentences.text: He continued to his sister’s village to find out if she had seen Simbegwire.
sentences.translation_zh: 他一路赶到姐妹所在的村子，想打听她是否见到了辛贝格维尔。

sentences.text: Simbegwire was playing with her cousins when she saw her father from far away.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔正和表兄妹们玩耍，远远地看见了父亲。

sentences.text: She was scared he might be angry, so she ran inside the house to hide.
sentences.translation_zh: 她害怕父亲会发火，于是连忙跑进屋里躲了起来。

sentences.text: But her father went to her and said, “Simbegwire, you have found a perfect mother for yourself.
sentences.translation_zh: 但父亲走到她跟前，温和地说道：“辛贝格维尔，你为自己找到了一位完美的母亲。

sentences.text: One who loves you and understands you.
sentences.translation_zh: 一个真正爱你、懂你的人。

sentences.text: I am proud of you and I love you.”
sentences.translation_zh: 我为你感到自豪，而且我也深爱着你。”

sentences.text: They agreed that Simbegwire would stay with her aunt as long as she wanted to.
sentences.translation_zh: 他们一致同意，只要辛贝格维尔愿意，她想在姑母家住多久都可以。

sentences.text: Her father visited her every day.
sentences.translation_zh: 父亲每天都来看望她。

sentences.text: Eventually, he came with Anita.
sentences.translation_zh: 后来有一天，他带着安妮塔一起来了。

sentences.text: She reached out for Simbegwire’s hand.
sentences.translation_zh: 安妮塔伸出手，去拉辛贝格维尔的手。

sentences.text: “I’m so sorry little one, I was wrong,” she cried.
sentences.translation_zh: “我真的非常抱歉，小家伙，是我做错了，”她流着泪说道。

sentences.text: “Will you let me try again?”
sentences.translation_zh: “你能再给我一次机会吗？”

sentences.text: Simbegwire looked at her father and his worried face.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔看看父亲，看到了他满是担忧的神情。

sentences.text: Then she stepped forward slowly and put her arms around Anita.
sentences.translation_zh: 接着，她慢慢走上前，张开双臂抱住了安妮塔。

sentences.text: The next week, Anita invited Simbegwire, with her cousins and aunt, to the house for a meal.
sentences.translation_zh: 第二周，安妮塔邀请辛贝格维尔连同她的表兄妹与姑母一起到家里聚餐。

sentences.text: What a feast!
sentences.translation_zh: 多么丰盛的一场盛宴啊！

sentences.text: Anita prepared all of Simbegwire’s favourite foods, and everyone ate until they were full.
sentences.translation_zh: 安妮塔准备了辛贝格维尔平时最爱吃的所有美食，大家都吃得饱饱的。

sentences.text: Then the children played while the adults talked.
sentences.translation_zh: 饭后大人们围坐谈心，孩子们在一旁欢快地玩耍。

sentences.text: Simbegwire felt happy and brave.
sentences.translation_zh: 辛贝格维尔感到既快乐又勇敢。

sentences.text: She decided that soon, very soon, she would return home to live with her father and her stepmother.
sentences.translation_zh: 她暗暗下了决心：很快，非常快，她就会回到家中，和父亲以及继母生活在一起。

rights.author: Rukia Nantale
rights.modifications: 压缩父亲出差前后的交代，以叙述代替歌词，保留虐待背景、避难与结局，提供完整逐句中文翻译与逐词语境释义。
